Description.SourceString: For all its bluster and self-assured strength, Dowdun Reach is a fortress designed to keep everyone out. There were no armies at their doors; the armies of Saradomin were too far to the south and dragons have no need for infantry when they can burn a kingdom from the skies. Yet, despite there being no need for safety, these walls stand strong and sturdy, weathering centuries of quiet neglect.
